scope: typed relational snapshots and validated chunk offsets

checks.round_trip: preserve entity and relation IDs, ordered ports, roles and repeated endpoints through C++ write and read
checks.independent: read Python-authored hypergraph with 3 entities, 2 relations, 5 port incidences, arities 2 and 3
checks.invariance: relabel IDs and reorder entity records or unordered ports, with counts and type/arity histograms equal
checks.rejection: reject duplicate and zero IDs, dangling endpoints, noncontiguous ranges, bad flags, inconsistent lengths and undeclared trailing ports
checks.index: match independently calculated offsets for all chunks including an unknown optional kind and end marker; classify a truncated suffix as incomplete and omit its chunk
checks.compatibility: initial categorical and event-only fixture hashes and existing diagnostics retained; verify installed evaluator with substrates disabled

limits: local engineering fixtures only; no calibration, structural complexity estimate, or scientific world runs
